entities.name: Hisayoshi Takeda
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hisayoshi Takeda  was a Japanese botanist whose father was the British diplomat Sir Ernest Satow. He was a founder of the Japanese Natural History Society, and is known for his campaign to preserve the environment at Oze, which is now Oze National Park.
